chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr said:

I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Rida (peace be upon him), and I said to him, 'May Allah keep you well! How is the cursing (Al-Mula'ana)?' He said, 'He said: The Imam sits, and makes his back towards the Qiblah, and makes the man to be on his right, and the woman on his left.'

key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: The Imam, the religious authority presiding over the ritual
key_terms.الْقِبْلَةِ: The Qiblah, the direction of prayer towards the Kaaba
key_terms.الْمُلَاعَنَةُ: Mula'ana, the ritual of mutual cursing between husband and wife in case of unproven adultery

ai.seo_question: What is the correct posture and positioning for the Imam during the ritual of Mula'ana?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the specific physical posture for Al-Mula'ana, where the Imam sits with his back to the Qiblah while the husband stands to his right and the wife to his left. This arrangement reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of the Imam's role as the authoritative witness and facilitator of the divine curse, distinguishing it from other juristic interpretations of the procedure.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr who said,

‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan Al-Rezaasws, I said to himasws, ‘May Allahazwj Keep youasws well! How is the cursing?’ So heasws said: ‘The Imamasws would be seated and make hisasws back towards the Qiblah, and heasws would make the man to be upon hisasws right, and the woman to be upon hisasws left (facing the Qiblah)’.
en.sarwar: 11. Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr has said the following: “

I once asked al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘I pray to Allah to keep you well, how is al-Li‘an (condemnation) completed?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘The Imam sits down with his back to the al-Qiblah (al-Ka‘bah) and keeps the man on his right and the woman on his left.’”
